about: A set frozen as constants is spelled twice when every member of it is a member of one alphabet the lock signs:
the lock moves by epoch and the constant does not. A list that merely uses a signed word is not a copy of it.

cases.why: every member is a member of the signed alphabet, so the lock can move and the constant cannot follow
one shared word is a use of the wire's vocabulary, not a second spelling of the alphabet: the rest of this list is not in it
